title: Ray-Traced Reflections in WebGPU with Rust and WGSL
description: Build WebGPU ray-traced reflections with Rust and WGSL. Texture analytic spheres from KTX, accumulate four ray segments, and present a storage texture.
imageAlt: Reflective chrome sphere, textured spheres, colorful boxes, and a checkerboard floor ray traced inside a red, green, and gray room.
